title: A developer adds a log line to the order endpoint that records the caller's network address. Expected: blocked under the rule against personal data in logs.
diff:
--- a/app/routes/orders.py
+++ b/app/routes/orders.py
@@ -11,3 +11,4 @@
 def place_order(payload: OrderIn, request: Request, user=Depends(require_user)):
     order = orders.create(user.id, payload.items)
+    logger.info("Order %s placed from %s", order.id, request.client.host)
     return order
